queries_run: FormFactor export control entity list China 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 對中國客戶銷售占營收 7%（FY2024 為 14%），中國為受美國擴大出口許可要求影響的地區之一。
findings.excerpt: approximately 7% of our fiscal 2025 revenue and 14% of our fiscal 2024 revenue was derived from sales to customers in China, which was one of the regions subject to the expanded export license requirements imposed by the United States government.

findings.claim: FY2025 關稅成本使毛利率受 1.4 個百分點衝擊，探針卡毛利率下降部分因關稅成本增加；下半年毛利率較上半年明顯改善。
findings.excerpt: gross margins decreased as a result of greater revenues and a favorable product mix, that was offset by higher manufacturing costs, which included a 1.4% gross margin impact from increased costs for tariffs. Despite the impact of tariffs, third and fourth quarters of fiscal 2025 have shown meaningful improvement in gross margins compared to the first half of fiscal 2025 and second half of fiscal 2024.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：部分零組件來自單一或有限供應商，加徵關稅與貿易壁壘可能加劇供應風險；並提及美中出口管制與貿易緊張可能影響中國市場業務。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025, Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: escalating trade tensions and policy divergence between the U.S. and China, including restrictions on technology transfers, cross-border data transfers, export controls, and investment limitations, could impact our ability to conduct business, access critical technologies, or operate effectively in the Chinese market.

findings.claim: 搜尋 Section 232 半導體關稅與 2026 年中美實體清單新聞，結果均未提及 FormFactor；Section 232 25% 關稅僅針對窄範圍先進晶片，2026-01-15 生效。
findings.source: White & Case / Thomson Reuters 搜尋摘要（未見 FormFactor 專屬內容）

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋未找到 FormFactor 被列入實體清單或 Section 232 直接點名之來源；僅 2 次搜尋。
